svg.title: Who voted for who: total points by voter and submitter
svg.desc: A directional heatmap. Rows are voters and columns are song submitters. Cell values are total points awarded.
svg.text: Rows are voters, columns are song submitters. Values are total points across 323 vote rows in 12 completed rounds.
Diagonal cells are blank because self-votes are not allowed. Total awarded points: 390.
